params.1273: Kill a cow so you can tan its hide into leather.
params.1274: If you don't have a sling, get one by trading with Corporal Boothe.
params.1275: Equip your sling by left clicking it in your inventory.
params.1276: Attack the cows in the field. If you use a ranged weapon you can attack over the fence.
params.2225: Don't forget to take the cowhide to make leather with!
